origin.description: Find the k nearest neighbors of each row. The default algorithm is the kd-tree.
origin.details: Indices are 1-based. Euclidean algorithms drop the point itself. CR uses the correlation distance 1 - x'y and also skips self.
origin.example: cbind(1:10, 1:10) k=5 for kd_tree, brute, and cover_tree distances; CR on cos and sin of seq(0.1, 6, length=10) k=3

translation.description: get_knn returns 1-based indices. The default is the sliding-midpoint kd-tree. An equal squared distance keeps the point already in the queue.
